import { Input, InputContainer, Label, Typography, Utility } from '@visa/nova-react';

export default function GeneratedUI() {
  return (
    <fieldset id={"node-0"}>
      <legend>
        {"Card details"}
      </legend>
      <Utility vFlex={true} vFlexCol={true} vGap={8}>
        <Label htmlFor={"node-0--cardholder"}>
          {"Cardholder name"}
        </Label>
        <InputContainer>
          <Input id={"node-0--cardholder"} name={"card-details[cardholder]"} type={"text"} />
        </InputContainer>
      </Utility>
      <Utility vFlex={true} vFlexCol={true} vGap={8}>
        <Label htmlFor={"node-0--number"}>
          {"Card number"}
        </Label>
        <InputContainer>
          <Input id={"node-0--number"} name={"card-details[number]"} type={"text"} />
        </InputContainer>
      </Utility>
      <Utility vFlex={true} vFlexCol={true} vGap={8}>
        <Label htmlFor={"node-0--expiry"}>
          {"Expiry (MM/YY)"}
        </Label>
        <InputContainer>
          <Input id={"node-0--expiry"} name={"card-details[expiry]"} type={"text"} />
        </InputContainer>
      </Utility>
      <Utility vFlex={true} vFlexCol={true} vGap={8}>
        <Label htmlFor={"node-0--security-code"}>
          {"Security code"}
        </Label>
        <InputContainer>
          <Input id={"node-0--security-code"} name={"card-details[security-code]"} type={"password"} />
        </InputContainer>
      </Utility>
      <Typography id={"node-0--notice"} tag={"p"} variant={"body-1"}>
        {"UI example only. No card validation or payment processing."}
      </Typography>
    </fieldset>
  );
}
